description: Read-only weekly probe for KOREA-WEEK-001 (owner 2026-11-12: check every week how many Korea online auctions run and whether new ones were added). Bounded run in the existing private inbox: upload this package, run source_remote.py once in a temporary always-on task (removed after its receipt; never the CRM bot) which uses the installed collector and the owner login file to read the Korea search form (auction groups) and search each group once, reporting every auction (house and day) of the coming 7 days with its lot count and whether the site collector sees it. No lot page, no bid, no source, CRM, HTML, media or bot change.
title: Korea online auctions of the week
